result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, Customer Data export within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion certification. The backup and legal-retention exceptions are customary and do not materially defeat the requirement. The amendment is narrowly scoped and preserves the existing termination economics and surviving rights. Drafting quality is reduced because the new paragraph is unnumbered and appears after the '18. INSURANCE' heading, incorrectly placing transition obligations within the insurance section. The margin comment also cites sections not shown in the supplied text, but that does not undermine the operative language.
